issues.detail: The Greek 'σπερμολογος' (spermologos) refers to a 'seed-gatherer' or 'seed-sower'. The Vietnamese translation 'người ba hoa' (someone who speaks/talks) is a significant loss of the specific imagery regarding the sowing of seeds.

The Greek 'συνεβαλλον αυτω' (synevallon autō) means 'contributed to him' or 'added to [his argument]'. The Vietnamese 'tranh luận với ông' (debated with him) changes the nature of the interaction from contributing/adding to a debate to an oppositional debate.
